item.title: Federal agents must limit tear gas for now at protests outside Portland ICE building, judge says
item.description: The temporary restraining order will be in effect for 14 days.

item.title: Miracles Santa Cruz gives performers with disabilities a chance to shine on stage
item.description: Miracles Santa Cruz was established in 2013 and remains an inclusive troupe where performers ages 14 and up can sing, dance, act and play bongos onstage regardless of their disabilities. To see what Miracles Santa Cruz is all about, the troupe will be having a public showcase Monday at the Colligan Theater.

item.title: Santa Cruz County RTC to discuss implementation of interim vision for rail trail segments
item.description: The Santa Cruz County Regional Transportation Commission has already decided to pursue a multiuse trail at the center of its rail corridor within three Mid County segments, but exactly how it plans to accomplish this — including potential removal of the tracks themselves — will be unpacked for commissioners and the public at a meeting this week.

item.title: Seahawks trace roots of resurgence to 2024 win over 49ers at Levi’s Stadium
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks have a 22-5 record since beating the 49ers at Levi's Stadium on Nov. 17 of last season.

item.title: Judge: Deal reached to protect identities of Epstein victims in documents release
item.description: Nearly 100 victims were harmed by sloppy redactions to a massive release of Epstein documents.

item.title: Santa Cruz Mountains | Puma protections could become permanent
item.description: To ensure the long-term survival of mountain lions, the California Fish and Game Commission is slated to vote to list the animals as endangered under the California Endangered Species Act at a meeting this month.

item.title: Federal immigration officials scout warehouses as they eye more detention space
item.description: Federal immigration officials are beginning to purchase some warehouses for detention and processing facilities.

item.title: Trump accused of distorting history of Mexican-American War to justify heavy hand in Latin America
item.description: A social media post by the White House commemorated the anniversary of the war.

item.title: Photo | Sit-down surfer slices through waves in Santa Cruz
item.description: A sit-down surfer uses a paddle to slice through a Monterey Bay wave on a recent sunny morning near Lighthouse Point in Santa Cruz.
